title: ROラトリオ Branch workspace, format version 1

name.description: Written on export for readers. Ignored on import; the ID next to it decides.

sockets.description: Cards and enchants in slot order, null for an empty slot. Armor takes its card in the first slot and enchants in the other three.

element.description: ratorio element ID a random option gives a weapon ("武器に聖属性を付与する"). Taken for a weapon in the right hand when the character is not endowed with an element; the original keeps it only as that endowment.

name.description: Written on export for readers. Ignored on import; the ID next to it decides.

value.description: The rolled value, in the unit the option uses.

randomOptions.description: Random options rolled on this piece, by position, null for an empty position. Which options a position can hold depends on the item.

zenyCost.description: What this piece costs to obtain, in zeny.

owned.description: false for a piece that is only being considered.

gearPieces.description: The locker: every piece, by ID.

jobName.description: Written on export for readers. Ignored on import; the ID next to it decides.

baseStats.description: Base stat points as allocated, without job or gear bonuses.

traitStats.description: Trait stat points as allocated. Defaults to all 0.

learnedSkills.description: ratorio skill ID to learned level. A skill that is not listed is not learned.

selfBuffs.description: ratorio skill ID to active level, for the job's own buffs and toggles.

supportBuffs.description: Buffs and debuffs from the first- to fourth-job support panels and the debuff panel, keyed by the upstream constant name without its CONF_ID_ prefix (for example BLESSING).

autoSpellId.description: ratorio auto-spell ID: a skill at the level some item casts it.

name.description: Written on export for readers. Ignored on import; the ID next to it decides.

level.description: The level it is cast at. Defaults to 0: the level the auto-spell has.

chancePerMille.description: How often it goes off, in per mille; one of the values the original offers.

autoSpells.description: Auto-spells that go off on a plain attack.

status.description: Base stats, HP, SP and the like.

attack.description: Attack, damage bonuses and weapon overrides.

skill.description: Skill damage, cast time and delays.

traitStatus.description: Trait stats and what follows from them.

customization.description: The original's performance customisation: numbers added on top of what the character has, by part and then by the upstream constant name without its CONF_ID_ prefix (for example attack.ATK_PLUS).

guildBuffs.description: Guild skills, gospel and stat-swap boosts, keyed by the buff's position in the original's panel, to its level or choice.

itemBuffs.description: Consumables and food, keyed by the buff's position in the original's panel, to its level or choice.

otherBuffs.description: Pet, manuals, party and other settings, keyed by the setting's position in the original's panel, to its level or choice.

timedItems.description: Active time-limited items. The same one can be listed more than once.

weaponElement.description: ratorio element ID the weapon is endowed with. Defaults to 0, no endow: the weapon keeps its own element.

costumeId.description: ratorio ID of the costume worn over the lower headgear. Defaults to 0, none.

arrowId.description: ratorio ID of the arrow, bullet or other ammunition. Defaults to 0, none.

speedPotion.description: ratorio attack-speed potion setting. Defaults to 0, none.

^(rightHand|leftHand|headTop|headMid|hea.description: The ID of a piece in gearPieces.

equipment.description: The locker piece worn in each slot. A missing slot is empty.

characterId.description: The ID of the character in characters that is this tree's root.

skillId.description: ratorio skill ID of the attack.

skillName.description: Written on export for readers. Ignored on import; the ID next to it decides.

skillSource.description: Where the character has the attack from when not from its job: something it wears (gear, a card, a scroll), or an auto-spell looked at on its own.

skillOptions.description: Skill-specific choices in upstream order, for example the cannonball of Arms Cannon. One that is left out takes the skill's default.

targetMonsterId.description: ratorio monster ID of the target.

targetMonsterName.description: Written on export for readers. Ignored on import; the ID next to it decides.

asPlayer.description: The target taken as a player: its HP, defense, resistances and the kind of battle.

ailments.description: Ailments and debuffs on the target.

targetSettings.description: The original's monster settings, by part and then by the upstream constant name without its MOB_CONF_…_ID_ prefix (for example buffs.ASSUMPTIO).

scenario.description: What is attacked and with what. Kept apart from the character on purpose.

parentId.description: The node this one builds on, or null when it builds directly on the root.

zenyCost.description: What this step costs, in zeny. A step without a cost is unpriced.

name.description: Written on export for readers. Ignored on import; the ID next to it decides.

value.description: The rolled value, in the unit the option uses.

randomOptions.description: Random options rolled on this piece, by position, null for an empty position. Which options a position can hold depends on the item.

zenyCost.description: What this piece costs to obtain, in zeny.

gearPiece.description: The piece to put in the slot, or null to empty it.

expectedItemId.description: The item this change was made for. When the slot holds a different item, the change no longer applies and its node is stale.

cardOrEnchantId.description: The card or enchant to place, or null to empty the socket.

name.description: Upstream constant name without its CONF_ID_ prefix.

position.description: The buff's position in the original's panel.

timedItems.description: Active time-limited items. The same one can be listed more than once.

autoSpellId.description: ratorio auto-spell ID: a skill at the level some item casts it.

name.description: Written on export for readers. Ignored on import; the ID next to it decides.

level.description: The level it is cast at. Defaults to 0: the level the auto-spell has.

chancePerMille.description: How often it goes off, in per mille; one of the values the original offers.

autoSpells.description: Auto-spells that go off on a plain attack.

elementId.description: ratorio element ID. 0 is no endow.

arrowId.description: ratorio ID of the ammunition. 0 is none.

gearPieceId.description: The ID of a piece in gearPieces.

^(rightHand|leftHand|headTop|headMid|hea.description: The ID of a piece in gearPieces.

equipment.description: The locker piece this loadout puts into each slot. A slot it does not list is left as it is.

gearLoadouts.description: Named sets of locker pieces, by ID.

baseStats.description: Base stat points as allocated, without job or gear bonuses.

traitStats.description: Trait stat points as allocated. Defaults to all 0.

cardsOrEnchants.description: By ratorio card or enchant ID.

spEffectChances.description: Chances taken for the SP effects that happen by chance, where the item's wording gives none.

activeSpEffects.description: States of SP effects counted as on all the time, rather than on average.
